Vendored (self-hosted, so the site works offline):
- GSAP 3.15.0 + ScrollTrigger — https://github.com/greensock/GSAP — GreenSock "no charge" standard license (https://gsap.com/standard-license)
- Lenis 1.3.26 — https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis — MIT
Effects in js/fx.js are vanilla-JS ports of ideas from React Bits (https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits): BlurText, CountUp, ShinyText, SpotlightCard, Magnet, ClickSpark, Squares-style moving tracks.
